title: Movement
description: A Movement, as stored in `beta-3-g<N>-movements` for `POST /movements`.

movementId.description: The Movement ID, minted by waste-tracking-id-backend. Unique.

orgId.description: The ID of the organisation that created the Movement.

wasteItems.description: The request's waste items. `POST /deliveries` reads their classifications to decide whether the Movement is hazardous.

items.description: A waste item, as the request sent it. Its shape is checked by the API's request schema, so it isn't repeated here.

createdAt.description: When the Movement was stored, as an ISO 8601 date-time.
